theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0), IsSmoothForm g → ∀ (a v : Euclid P) (ℓ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ℓ → ∫ u in Ioo 0 ℓ, exteriorDerivative g (a + u • v) (fun _ => v) = g (a + ℓ • v) (fun i => i.elim0) - g a (fun i => i.elim0)
